svg.text: Class & Database Architecture Diagram — Module 5: Admin & Operations

g.text: 🔒 Privacy: Zero Raw-Content telemetry metadata only
Trigger: Triggers real-time notification to Admin UI
🔒 Append-Only Ledger: UPDATE and DELETE are REVOKED
User-reported AI verdict dispute review feed
• Failed login spike: → Review authentication logs
• Password Vault down: → Investigate component health
• Missing score inputs: → Check data integration
• +40% scam warnings: → Review scam activity trends
Rule-based recommendations provide clear next steps for admins
Index: event_name, created_at (enables fast 7-day baseline query)
Zero Raw-Content: Event metadata only (No raw message bodies)
Aggregates profile counters with Zero Raw-Content boundaries
Powers AnomalyDetectionEngine with fast precalculated averages
